## 8d46d66e31b0

**Finding: reproduced default-generation invariant and validator defect.** The generator source SHA-256 is `eab6b3c105e8579490058d960783489f117963dff1a4dc2141ac4ffb90fc7e9b`, matching the immutable audit assignment.

At seed `0`, sample index `2`, no difficulty and no overrides, the default generator chooses template cells `(1,1)`, `(1,3)`, and `(2,2)`. They are three cardinally disconnected singleton color-2 components, contradicting the declared invariant “exactly one connected 2-color blob.” `self_check` nevertheless returns `[]`. Canonical Racket extracts only one singleton object and stamps one interior cell per frame, while the advertised whole-template interpretation stamps all three normalized cells; the outputs differ.

The scene is therefore generated by the default path and accepted by the validator, but it is outside the generator’s own documented connected-template domain. Checks performed: actual canonical Racket matched all **5/5** published pairs; the first disconnected case was found after three deterministic cases in a declared search window of seeds and sample indices `0..31`; actual Racket and the documented whole-template output were both recorded. I made no changes to this audit target. The exact input, outputs, hashes, validator result, and command are in `checks/audit-8d46d66e31b0.json`.
